reviewNotes: Reviewed 25 purchase dialogues, named NPC voices and culinary details. Pierre intentionally takes false credit for grown/cooked/foraged goods; preserved. Dynamic names are catalogue labels/appositions; pronouns refer to explicit ceva/produs rather than guessing item gender. Lexicon masculine alternatives agree with ceva and bucătar; articles remain adjacent empty placeholders. Retained original general-store wording in PurchasedItem_2_QualityLow_Willy despite its key. Casserole remains a general baked dish, not a narrower soufflé; vinaigrette rendered by its oil/vinegar description.

PurchasedItem_3_NonRude.source: I went shopping last night and picked up {1} {2} on sale for only {3}g.#$e# I couldn't pass up that great price.
PurchasedItem_3_NonRude.translation: Am fost aseară la cumpărături și am luat {1}{2} la reducere, cu doar {3}g.#$e# Nu puteam rata un preț atât de bun.

PurchasedItem_5_VegetableOrFruit.source: I bought the tastiest {2} from Pierre's shop the other day. #$b#He said that he grew the thing in his own backyard. I didn't know Pierre was such a talented farmer!$h#$b#Looks like you might have some competition, huh?

PurchasedItem_5_Cooking.source: I bought the tastiest {2} from Pierre's shop the other day. #$b#He said he cooked the thing himself using local ingredients. I didn't know Pierre was such {3} {4} chef!

PurchasedItem_5_Foraged.source: I bought the tastiest {2} from Pierre's shop the other day. He said he found it himself while exploring the mountains. I didn't know Pierre was such a talented forager!

PurchasedItem_Abigail_QualityLow.source: Hey. We had one of those {2}s you sold at the shop for dinner last night... I guess it was starting to go bad and my Dad couldn't bear to throw it out.$h#$b#Unfortunately it tasted like {3}.$s

PurchasedItem_Abigail_QualityHigh.source: Hey. We had one of those {2}s you sold at the shop for dinner last night... I guess it was starting to go bad and my Dad couldn't bear to throw it out.$h#$b#It was still pretty good, though.
